name: Mask of the Urdefolcin
entries: This wooden mask carries the silent, predatory presence of an urdefolcin.
While wearing the mask, you can transform into an urdefolcin at will. While transformed, you use the urdefolcin's stat block in place of your own game statistics.

If your hit points are reduced to 0 while you are transformed into an urdefolcin, you immediately revert to your original form. After reverting in this way, you cannot transform into an urdefolcin with the mask again until you finish a long rest.
